title: Retro Snake Neon
description: Guide the glowing serpent through cyberspace, devouring energy crystals without biting your own tail or hitting the barriers.
controls: Arrow keys or W/A/S/D to turn. Space to pause.
author: Neon Retro Labs

title: Tetris Classic
description: Rotate and drop falling geometric blocks into seamless horizontal rows to clear lines and rack up massive scores.
controls: Arrow keys to move/soft drop, Up to rotate, Space for hard drop, C to hold piece.
author: Blockworks Studio

title: Slope 3D Runner
description: High-speed 3D tunnel runner! Steer a futuristic neon sphere at breakneck speeds while dodging deadly obstacles.
controls: A/D or Left/Right Arrow Keys or mouse movement to steer sphere.
author: HyperSpeed Games

title: 2048 Classic
description: Combine identical tiles together with swipe moves to build exponential values until you achieve the legendary 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow keys or Touch swipe to slide all tiles across the grid.
author: Mathematician Collective

title: Flappy Bird Arcade
description: Flap your tiny wings through treacherous green pipes in this precision timing classic. How far can you fly?
controls: Spacebar or mouse click / tap to flap upwards.
author: Pixel Aviators

title: Cyber Pong DX
description: The grandfather of video gaming reimagined in neon cyberpunk aesthetic. Play against reactive AI or battle a friend locally.
controls: Player 1: W/S or Mouse. Player 2: Up/Down arrow keys.
author: Digital Court

title: Breakout Neon DX
description: Shatter high-density neon brick walls with bouncy physics balls, dynamic bounce angles, and explosive particle bursts.
controls: Mouse or Arrow Keys to position paddle. Click to launch ball.
author: Smash Works

title: Asteroids Vector 1979
description: Pilot your lone starship through dense meteor fields, blasting giant space boulders into dust with your laser blaster.
controls: Left/Right to rotate, Up to thrust, Space to fire lasers, Shift for hyperspace.
author: Vector Space Systems

title: T-Rex Dino Runner
description: The classic offline desert marathon! Leap over prickly cacti and duck beneath low-flying prehistoric pterodactyls.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to crouch/duck.
author: Chromium Paleontology

title: Minesweeper Pro
description: Carefully deduce hidden explosive naval mines using numerical neighbor clues without detonating a single trap.
controls: Left Click to uncover cell, Right Click to flag suspected mine.
author: Logic Grid Labs

title: Connect 4 Arcade
description: Drop vibrant checker tokens into a vertical matrix grid to line up 4 tokens in a row before your adversary.
controls: Click columns to drop your checker disc.
author: Hasbro Classics Tribute

title: Hextris Arcade
description: Rotate the central hexagon to match cascading colored bricks in groups of 3 or more before they overflow the perimeter.
controls: Left / Right arrow keys or click canvas halves to rotate hexagon.
author: Hexagon Games
